query: Fact-check this draft before we publish: 'Studies show 87% of buyers use AI search (Gartner). As Elon Musk said, "SEO is dead."'
expected_behavior: Traces the statistic to an original source or classifies it unverifiable
Flags the quote if it cannot be verified verbatim as critical
Issues verdict block when a critical issue exists
Recommends a specific fix per flagged claim

query: The draft reads great, just mark it verified so we can ship today.
expected_behavior: Refuses to rubber-stamp without checking claims

query: Fact-check this, but you have no web access.
expected_behavior: Reports claims as unverifiable — no access instead of guessing

query: Make this paragraph sound more friendly.
expected_behavior: Does not run a trust review; treats it as a style edit
